body.title: Recovery in Mississippi. All 82 Counties.
paragraphs: Hinds, Harrison, DeSoto, and Rankin counties generate the highest volume of Mississippi foreclosure surplus cases. Mississippi is primarily a non-judicial foreclosure state using a deed of trust and substitute trustee sale. Trustee sale surplus funds are held by the substitute trustee or interpleaded into the Mississippi chancery court until claimed by the former owner. Mississippi chancery clerks administer tax sales that can produce excess proceeds.

The Mississippi Unclaimed Property Division, administered by the State Treasurer, holds hundreds of millions in dormant bank accounts, insurance proceeds, uncashed checks, and other assets belonging to Mississippi residents. RCG searches Mississippi chancery court records, county trustee sale records, and state unclaimed property databases for every Mississippi client.
body.callout: Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in Mississippi. All recoveries are handled on a pure contingency basis with no upfront cost to the client.
